rationale: The plan correctly identifies the question as a condition-by-time interaction with time as a factor, but then explicitly declines the LRT full-vs-reduced test (the reference approach) on the basis of an internal 'permitted method set' rule, substituting per-coefficient Wald tests on the three interaction terms; this is a defensible approximation but is not the joint test, and the plan never addresses the extra multiplicity incurred by selecting genes with padj<0.05 on any one of three coefficients, nor does it define a reduced model. Design specification is otherwise explicit and dataset-anchored (reference levels stated for both factors, simple effects plus interaction contrasts reported side by side), and it notes 25 samples without reconciling that against the stated 2x4x3=24 layout, which QC should have interrogated. QC, filtering (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, justified by smallest cell size), in-model median-of-ratios normalization, BH at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, p-value histogram, apeglm shrinkage, and trajectory clustering for the >=3-timepoint pattern are all correct and concretely specified. Enrichment is well constructed (tested-gene universe, org.Hs.eg.db, size window, rrvgo, short-list power caveat, Reactome version), and the final report names design, contrasts, thresholds, gene counts, diagnostics, and sessionInfo.
